guide.hero: How your records become something useful, and where common tasks live.

guide.noResults: No matching section. Ask HustleK in your own words.

stars.question: What are the seven stars?
stars.answer: They are profile · infancy · school years · twenties · later life · work · now. Career, finance, growth, relationships, health, and rest are the six life areas in the HustleK dashboard, not stars.

brightness.question: What do brightness and Polaris mean?
brightness.answer: Brightness records how many interview layers you actually opened. Coverage can reach L4; L5 appears only after you ratify a proposal. Polaris is a summary derived from those inputs, not the source record.

source.question: What does HustleK read?
source.answer: Your wiki and records are the detailed source. HustleK reads that original material when it answers; Polaris is a derived summary rather than the source it should quote from.

ratify.question: When does a suggestion change my profile?
ratify.answer: Never by itself. What HustleK suggests remains a proposal until you ratify it. Only a proposal you confirm can be applied to your model or open L5.

data.question: Where do privacy, safety, and exports live?
data.answer: Privacy choices and account export are explicit controls. IDEN is a portable identity summary. If a message needs urgent support, the app shows support resources before an ordinary reply and does not contact services for you.

refund.question: How do I get a refund?
refund.answer: Request it in Manage subscription, in Settings. If you have a payment, that screen shows whether you can get a refund right now, and why.

export.question: How do I export my records?
export.answer: Choose Account data export in My data, in Settings, to get your account data as one file. The file also lists what it leaves out and why.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Choose Delete account in Account, in Settings. Deleting cannot be undone, so export anything you need first.

notifications.question: Where do I change notifications?
notifications.answer: In the phone app, turn them on or off in Permissions, in Settings. The web version sends no notifications.
